verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own docs name a no-code Workflow Builder and an 'Agentic Voice AI platform to automate, assist, and analyze customer interactions end-to-end.' They also cite an AI Receptionist that answers and routes calls on its own, and rule-based call handling, so first-party background automation exists. The evidence is only one-line marketing and navigation labels, with no detail on what Workflow Builder can trigger or run, how autonomous agents are configured, or any hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: documented Workflow Builder triggers, actions and scheduling, configuration depth for autonomous AI agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration that automations run unattended.
